content: Screening methods, such as the Oral Glucose Tolerance Test (OGTT), particularly the 75-gram OGTT, are extensively utilized to confirm the diagnosis of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM). The diagnostic criteria established by the International Association of Diabetes and Pregnancy Study Groups (IADPSG) provide standardized guidelines for identifying GDM. These criteria include specific glucose level thresholds that must be met during the OGTT.
